name: Format Markdown for Telegram
description: Converts Markdown, as a model writes it, into the HTML Telegram accepts, for sending with parse_mode HTML. Telegram's HTML has only bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, links, code, pre and blockquote, and strict nesting rules, so headings become bold lines, list items bullet or numbered lines, tables a monospaced block and rules a line of dashes; code inside bold or a link is set apart from it, a code block inside a quote stands outside it, inline code and links inside a quote are text, raw HTML in the source is shown as text, and links Telegram cannot open keep their text only. Strikethrough needs two tildes. Soft line breaks stay newlines. Takes {markdown} (or {text} when that is absent or blank), or a reply hook's own {response, authentication}; returns {text, parse_mode: "HTML"}. To format an agent bot's replies, create it with "replyOperation": "v/ops/telegram/format": a reply hook's parse_mode wins over the bot's parseMode. An application with its own replyOperation calls this after its own processing and returns its text and parse_mode. The adapter splits a long reply at a line break where it can, so inline formatting nearly always stays whole; a part whose tags the cut separates, most often a long code block or quote, is refused by Telegram and resent as the plain text it shows. A pure conversion: no bot and no ability.

text.description: The Markdown to convert, when markdown is absent

response.description: A reply hook's agent response: a string, or a map read for text, response, content, message or result, as the adapter reads any reply

authentication.description: A reply hook's authentication record; not used

parse_mode.description: Always HTML: the parse_mode the text is sent under
